paragraphs.text:
Find the skill you selected and the area of the ship it is to be 
used, then consult the appropriate listed entry:
• If listen on ‘B’-deck, go to 515.
• If listen on ‘D’-deck, go to 512.
• If Spot Hidden on ‘B’-deck, go to 512.
• If Spot Hidden on ‘C’-deck, go to 512.
• If Track on ‘A’-deck, go to 507.
• If Track on ‘B’-deck, go to 507.
• If Anthropology on ‘B’-deck, go to 512.
• If Anthropology on ‘D’-deck, go to 505.
When done, return to 480.
